about.heroTitle: A Better Way to Study Together
about.belief:
FocusLily was created with a simple belief:
No student should have to study alone.
about.leadP1: Around the world, millions of students struggle to stay focused, motivated, and consistent. Traditional study spaces can feel isolating, while social platforms often create distractions instead of helping students reach their goals.
about.leadP2: FocusLily reimagines online studying by combining the accountability of studying with others and the comfort of a beautiful virtual world. Instead of joining a crowded video call, students enter magical study realms where they can focus, grow, and connect with like-minded learners.
about.missionBody: To help students build better study habits through focus, community, and consistency. Productivity should feel motivating, peaceful, and rewarding — not stressful or overwhelming. FocusLily makes studying feel like entering a calm world built specifically for learning.
about.feature1Body: Join study rooms filled with students working toward their own goals. The presence of others creates accountability and motivation while keeping a distraction-free environment.
about.feature2Body: Study inside carefully crafted environments inspired by magical libraries, moonlit forests, floating gardens, ancient halls, and other immersive worlds.
about.feature3Body: Take part comfortably through customizable avatars and profiles — a welcoming space where the focus stays on learning.
about.feature4Body: Connect with students who share similar goals, subjects, and study schedules.
about.feature5Body: Track focus time, maintain streaks, celebrate milestones, and watch your progress grow over time.
about.visionIntro: We imagine a future where students from every corner of the world gather in one shared learning space — a place where:
about.visionMore: FocusLily is more than a study platform. It is a virtual world built around learning.
about.nameBody: The lily symbolizes growth, calmness, and progress. Just as a lily slowly blooms over time, meaningful learning happens through small, consistent efforts every day. FocusLily represents that journey — helping students grow one focused session at a time.
about.tagline: Study Together. Grow Together. Bloom Together.

about.title: Why Focuslily exists
about.lead: Not a company story — a set of ideas worth building around.

philosophy.whyFocusBody: Focus is the single most valuable resource you have. Not time — focus. An hour of deep work produces more than a day of scattered attention. Focuslily exists because most productivity tools add more notifications, more tabs, more choices — the very things that destroy focus. We believe the best tool is the one that removes itself from your attention, not the one that begs for it.
philosophy.whyConsistencyBody: Motivation is unreliable. Consistency isn't. One focused session is good. A hundred, strung together — that's transformational. Focuslily is designed to make consistency the path of least resistance. Connected habits, visible streaks, and progress that compounds: every small action builds on the last. The people who grow aren't the ones who work hardest once — they're the ones who keep showing up.
philosophy.whyVisibleBody: You can't sustain what you can't see. When progress is invisible, doubt fills the gap. Focuslily makes your effort tangible — not to brag, but to remind you that your work counts. A streak, a chart, a growing forest. These aren't gamification tricks. They're mirrors. They reflect what you've already done so you have a reason to keep going.
philosophy.whySimplicityBody: Every new tool is a new account, a new sync problem, a new context switch. More apps rarely means more productive — it usually means more overwhelmed. Focuslily replaces a scattered stack with one connected system. Not because we added every feature — because we connected the ones that matter.

about.nameBody: A lily doesn't bloom overnight. It grows from still water, one layer at a time — consistent, unhurried, inevitable. That's how meaningful progress works: not in dramatic leaps, but in quiet, steady layers. Focuslily is named after that kind of growth.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything you need to know about Focuslily.
faq.a1: Yes. The core experience — focus sessions, basic analytics, habits, and study rooms — is free. Premium plans with deeper insights and advanced features will be available in the future.
faq.q2: Do I need to download anything?
faq.a2: No. Focuslily works in any modern browser. Just create an account and start. No installation, no setup wizard.
faq.q3: How is Focuslily different from a Pomodoro timer?
faq.a3: A timer measures time. Focuslily connects time to your plans, habits, goals, and analytics. Your focus data feeds recommendations, your habits link to achievements, and your progress stays visible — it's an ecosystem, not a stopwatch.
faq.q4: Can I study with friends on Focuslily?
faq.a4: Absolutely. Join shared study rooms, send friend requests, and study alongside others in immersive ambient environments. The presence of others creates natural accountability without distraction.
faq.a5: Yes. Your habits, analytics, and focus data are private by default. We never sell your data. You choose what is visible to others.
faq.q6: What browsers and devices are supported?
faq.a6: Focuslily works in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge on desktop and mobile. Native apps for iOS and Android are on the roadmap.
faq.a7: Yes. Focuslily is for anyone who wants to build better habits and focus more deeply — professionals, freelancers, writers, researchers, and anyone pursuing meaningful work.
faq.q8: Can I import data from other tools?
faq.a8: Not yet, but it's on the roadmap. Focuslily is designed to replace scattered tools, so bringing your data in is a natural next step.
faq.q9: Does Focuslily have a mobile app?
faq.a9: Focuslily works on mobile browsers today, and native apps for iOS and Android are planned. The mobile experience is already optimized for smaller screens.
faq.a10: You pick an environment, set your focus length, and start. The timer tracks your session, ambient sound plays, and your results automatically feed into your analytics and habit tracking — no manual logging.
faq.a11: Yes. Choose your study realm, set ambient sounds, pick themes and backgrounds, configure timer lengths, and personalize your avatar — Focuslily adapts to your preferences.
faq.a12: You can reach us through the Help section in the app, or visit our community for tips and support from other Focuslily users.
